scope: Read-only preparation review of the package staging script. The script was not run and no release-stage directory was created by this review. Final staging, Lake configuration loading, source-byte inventory validation, and final-entry compilation remain parent-owned.

resolved_findings.issue: The initial roots-prefix list with only two globs did not make other closure modules buildable in the pinned Lake version.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both roots and globs now use the exact sorted list of every mathematical source module plus FinalKLS500Audit. Each source directly matches a Glob.one and therefore is buildable.

resolved_findings.issue: The initial copy path did not explicitly bind the copied audit source and report files to their final verification/QA receipts.
resolved_findings.resolution: The script now validates the final receipt -> summary -> completion -> manifest chain, the summary -> audit-execution -> audit-source chain, and final receipt -> PDF QA -> current and copied PDF/TeX hashes.

source_fidelity_checks.checked: The manifest reports exactly 1710 and contains exactly 1710 provenance entries. Completion pins that manifest; the summary pins completion and audit execution; audit execution pins the audit source.

Each mathematical source is checked against its recorded SHA-256 before copy and the copied target is checked against that same hash. The copied audit source is checked against audit-execution.source_sha256.
Successful accepted final receipt and summary are required. Receipt pins summary and successful four-page QA; QA pins current TeX and PDF.
Copied TeX and PDF are rehashed against the same QA receipt.
The stage writes a source inventory and staging receipt while explicitly labeling the separate Lake configuration and entry check pending.

pending_marker_checks.meaning: No currently defined pending-status marker can pass into a copied public brief or README. Removing/replacing those markers remains contingent on final verification.

lake_configuration_review.read_only_expression_check: Evaluated only the pure modules/module_array/config expressions from the AST against the current 1699-module manifest plus the sealed 11-module extension plan. No imports, writes, copies, or package-stage script statements were executed.
lake_configuration_review.configuration_loading_scope: Lake itself has not loaded this planned configuration in this review; the parent will validate the actual staged file.

local_documentation.evidence: roots mark locality; globs specify build selection; isBuildableModule requires a direct glob match or a prefix root that itself matches a glob.
LeanLib.findModule? locates imports only when isBuildableModule is true.
Glob.one matches exactly its module name.

reproduction_and_record_preservation.checked: Verification receipts, complete recursive review directories, logs, and all five recorded-run Python scripts are preserved. Recursive review copying includes reviewer artifacts and range author-support files; only .lake and __pycache__ directories are excluded.

README identifies the range entry, numerical entry, exhaustive audit, pinned dependencies, and historical paths in the direct-rebuild scripts. It offers Lake as the portable reproduction route without claiming a second complete Lake build. Independent reviewer artifacts are explicitly outside the Lean import search path.
The ignore file does not exclude every .log file; it ignores only the root LaTeX compile log, preserving addability of verification logs.

remaining_parent_checks: Successful final proof and PDF QA receipts with the field names used by the staging script.
Run stage_package.py only after those gates pass and all three publication markers are resolved.
Load the actual staged Lake configuration and compile/check the final entry as planned.
Verify the final staged source inventory, report hashes, and absence of public pending markers; do not label the preparation review a second full Lake build.
